mcqs.question: Which of the following components controls communication between the CPU, RAM, storage devices, and other peripherals?
Which statement is NOT correct about the CPU Socket?
options: It provides mechanical support to the processor
It provides electrical connections between the CPU and the motherboard
It is used to install memory modules (RAM)
It is the location where the processor is installed on the motherboard
mcqs.answer: It is used to install memory modules (RAM)

mcqs.question: Which of the following types of expansion slots is commonly used for installing graphics cards?
Which of the following components is responsible for onboard sound functionality?
Which statement is correct about the CMOS battery?
options: It provides power to store BIOS settings, date, and time even when the computer is switched off
It initializes hardware during startup and loads the operating system
It manages data flow within the computer
It is used to add additional cards to the computer
mcqs.answer: It provides power to store BIOS settings, date, and time even when the computer is switched off

mcqs.question: Which of the following types of storage connectors is used for modern NVMe SSDs?
Which of the following components helps dissipate heat generated by components such as the CPU and chipset?
Which statement is NOT correct about the BIOS / UEFI Chip?
options: It is stored on a chip located on the motherboard
It is used to add additional cards to the computer
mcqs.answer: It is used to add additional cards to the computer

mcqs.question: Which of the following types of expansion slots is used for installing sound cards?
Which of the following components is responsible for network and internet connectivity?
Which statement is correct about the power connector?
options: It receives power from the Power Supply Unit (PSU) and distributes it to motherboard components
It initializes hardware during startup and loads the operating system
It manages data flow within the computer
It is used to add additional cards to the computer
mcqs.answer: It receives power from the Power Supply Unit (PSU) and distributes it to motherboard components
